text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 319 Harvie Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply (September 17, 2020) for 319 Harvie Avenue, Folder No. 20 195103 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to February 28, 2021. 2. Directed the Appellant to take immediate steps for Item 2 in the Order to Comply (September 17, 2020) for 319 Harvie Avenue, Folder No. 20 195103 PRS 00 IV, to ensure the safety and security through bracing and through access restriction to the property, and to the satisfaction of the Municipal Standards Officer.
